safeguards: The public source subscribes to inventory objects and containment; its current carried-load helper follows parent edges and rejects a fireplace root, cycle, missing object or duplicate match. The newly assessed problem is that a valid objectless fungible stack is currently grouped with the missing-object case.

The selected native current journey camp continuation checks for and rejects occupied fireplace stations before breaking that camp. Settlement fireplace placement is a separate source path and its full departure lifecycle is not established by the camp guard.

The travel test labels five resolved encounter choices against one identical post-state fixture; it does not execute five native encounter paths. Its travel_camps to continue_public_active_journey selector has both ordered markers in the reconstructed pinned source; substring assertions still do not prove all causal paths.

Thermal projection rejects truncated, zero-total or over-60-day itinerary forecasts, uses a deliberately zero weatherproofing input and carries state between its selected legs. Zero-duration stationary projection and sentinel representation retain their earlier open policy and valid-admission questions.

candidates.classification: New bounded current simulator/native authority mismatch; distinct first failure from the existing parametric-instance mass difference and tactical stack aggregation.
candidates.trace: Native inventory grants create stable physical objects only for defined nonfungible, measured, food or qualifying equipment/container rows; ordinary fungible stacks can have no InventoryObject. An ordinary arrow is a simple, non-food, non-measured 0.05 kg catalog item without those capabilities, and starting Witch Hunter and Forester kits specify arrow stacks; successful merchant purchases also use the same checked grant when no stack is merged. The simulator public_row_is_carried returns false when a row has zero matching physical objects, so its personal and party load estimates omit such objectless rows before the quantity/mass calculation. Native personal dry mass uses the fireplace-root filter, whose successful no-object result is false (therefore the row is included), and multiplies normal catalog mass by quantity. A 24-arrow personal stack therefore contributes 1.2 kg under these selected normal source assumptions to native personal dry mass but zero to the simulator estimate. Whether such a stack is visible to a particular run and whether any readiness boundary is crossed were not observed. The simulator can also omit ordinary shared stacks from its party aggregate; no matching native party-wide mass authority is asserted.
candidates.connected_repair: Make the public carried classification distinguish a valid fungible stack without a physical object from a missing required or duplicate object identity; preserve fireplace/repair-root exclusion and fail-closed handling for malformed graphs. Use the authoritative carried load or a shared projection where possible, including all personal and party stacks, water, food and authenticated instance masses. Coordinate with the separately recorded instance-mass and tactical aggregation contracts without treating them as the same first failure.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separate implementation and validation authorization, compare ordinary arrow and other valid fungible stacks against the strategic authority, with nonfungible, nested, fireplace-rooted, duplicate and missing-required-object controls and a supported readiness threshold case.
candidates.discovery: partial; actual simulator setup and cache snapshots, all item grant variants, party-load policy, threshold reachability and historical aliases remain open

candidates.classification: New bounded current provisioning producer-to-native-consumer authority question; related to but distinct from the existing water post-refill forecast.
candidates.trace: The simulator settlement-only provisioner gathers every public personal inventory row belonging to living members and every shared party row, then counts food lots by row ID without checking their physical root custody. A supported container placement removes only the root vessel inventory row and retains child object edges and child rows while relocating the root to a fireplace. A personal or shared food lot nested below that vessel remains identifiable by the child row in the provisioner, but native travel-food consumption explicitly filters fireplace-rooted rows from both party and personal candidates. The catalog gives a cooking pan 2,500 ml capacity and one travel ration 813 ml exterior volume and 2,500 kcal; the generic container insertion and fireplace placement source have custody, mutability, capacity and fixture guards. Therefore, conditional on a visible valid nested ration and suitable remaining guards, the forecast can count calories that native travel consumption excludes until retrieval. This is a source-derived discrepancy, not an observed departure, executed reducer or claim that the simulator itself creates the cooking state.
candidates.illustration: For one living member, a hypothetical 1,440-minute plan plus the configured one-day surplus has a 12,000 kcal target. Four carried rations plus one fireplace-rooted ration total 12,500 kcal to the provisioner, while only 10,000 kcal remain in those carried rations; with zero body reserve and sufficient water, the first calculation buys zero rations and the latter would require one 2,500 kcal ration. A separate native current-journey-camp gate requires vessels to be cleared before breaking that camp; it does not by itself prove a settlement departure or the proposed state is reachable.
candidates.connected_repair: Feed provisioning from the same carried-food custody authority used by native consumption, while preserving personal/shared ownership, measured food lots, nested carried containers, root exclusion, cache consistency and valid settlement/camp lifecycle. Reconcile the distinct water forecast and stack-load findings without adding duplicate stock authorities.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separate implementation and validation authorization, cover food in a carried nested vessel, a placed settlement vessel and a cleared journey camp, for both custody scopes, along with ordinary and measured lots and a known forecast target.
candidates.discovery: partial; complete departure and settlement custody lifecycle, admissible public snapshot/cache ordering, exact policy, actual shortfall and historical aliases remain open
